To connect with a demon it must first be greeted. It must be welcomed. I have found this design accomplishes two purposes.

The first use welcomes the entity to you. Once the demon has been welcomed to you, tracing this design after will inform an entity you are presenting an offering to it. (see offerings)

Goetic geometry is believed to be the oldest language of the demonic. It can be used to communicate, perform tasks, reveal information about a specific demon, and more. When we use an object such as a planchette to trace goetic geometry, a demon will respond with its own goetic tracing if it is willing.

RESPONSE AND INTERPRETATION
If the demon responds by tracing a design, the resulting goetic geometry can be interpreted differently depending on the surface the tracing is on. The same goetic tracing will read differently on a ouija board than it will on another design.

These are the Code keys. They are used to bind information across time and space. On the pediment slate, move the ring over the keys or numbers you wish to have reveal information. If the entity is willing, it will provide an answer in response.

Keys of binding and words of command over the chief demons from the lost book of Rehoboam.

a1. Letter written to Abijam, son of Rehoboam
Translated into Latin from the Hebrew script

My son Abijam. In these later days I feel the lord god’s call to sleep in the city of David. Being of the point of death I have thought it my duty, my son, to leave thee an inheritance beyond any other riches I have enjoyed. Secrets of wisdom passed from the servants of the lord god to my father. A command of knowledge and obedience which has bestowed upon this line the riches you see me in the enjoyment of. I command you to carefully engrave in your memory all that I say unto you.

You, my son, are the heir to this gift. A power commanding the obedience of celestial creatures. A power second only to the angels which govern them. Use these gifts so you may reunite the grand kingdom. If you do not intend to use for good purpose the secrets which I here teach you, I command you rather to cast these gifts into the fire.

I have toiled long over the gifts of my father. Symbols of command of which I pass to you. However there was, within its tracings, a deeper knowledge overlooked. An inner working of markings that comprise these symbols. My gift to you is not only the seals of their command to obtain knowledge but the edict markings to which they must serve.

Binding of an entity
While a demon's name does grant power, a demon will only fully obey those who invoke the keys of binding. Symbols that tie to the reigns of its master. When all are invoked, the keys of binding grant complete control over the demon.

Binding Keys of Commencement
All demons must obey keys of bindings. While there are many keys to command an entity, a demon must first be bound to service with one of the six commencement keys.

His kidneys are failing. The giant fucking box looms over his bed every god damn day. My life is work and mixing bag after bag of dialysate. I tried to paint it bright colors but the paint wont stick. Three hours every day. No child deserves this. Please don’t hurt him anymore. Please. Just please make him better. Please don’t make me watch my son die.

He closed his little eyes last night. I watched him because I haven’t slept in days. I stared at him while that fucking machine hummed him to sleep. I held his hand as his tiny lungs convulsed with their final breath. He left me. You took him from me. You fucking took him from me!

I begged, I prayed, I pleaded, I worked, I paid, I sang him to sleep, I fed him when he was too weak to lift his hands, I never slept, I left him alone scared every fucking day with the TV on never knowing if I would come back to a dead child. I sold my time with him for one more dollar to try and keep him alive because you did nothing! Why did you do nothing!? What the fuck are you.

I’m hearing things. It started small. Things that would make me question if I even heard anything at all but I’m almost certain something is speaking to me. Please speak to me. I’ve given up everything. I’ve sacrificed everything. I need it. I FUCKING DESERVE IT!

YOU FAILED ME! No god would rip a mother from her child. No righteous creator would stand by while that child withers away in agony to die. I refuse to worship a fake god that watches in silence as I offer everything! I gave my love, my wealth, my body until there was nothing left and you still expect devotion.

I gave you everything, and you left me alone to suffer. You turned your back, and I will do the same. In the oversight of your indifference, I will find the dark and forgotten things that hear my suffering. There are older and wiser beings than an absent god.

I have accepted my greed. The rest of this world is free to burn in the smoldering shadows of this vessel. Take what you want. Give me my son and I will give you God's creation to defile as it has done to me.

Please speak to me. I know you’re reaching out to me. I will find a way.

I’ve tried to speak with god. Words thrown into the void. I’ve lost so much. Burning precious moments with prayer. But there are things in the forgotten corners that will listen. They have taken my offering. The eidola I now share my home with poke and prod along my walls but are unable to take me. I slip in and out of lucidity always to return with clear memories of my visions. In the dark corners of atrament, I have seen what's to come. A monolith older than the earth that has known the worship of the powerful and the wretched frozen in black stone. I will open the gate and we will cross the threshold together.

In feckless youth I long believed
That all but I had been deceived

I laughed at holy church’s chatter
The folly in a life hereafter

In waning years of journey’s arc
I found myself within a forest dark

My eyes and hands began to shutter
The living veil would pierce and stutter
Pulled through earth and burning thorns
Submerged below the living forms
I felt the rage of wasted moments
Loves I’d lost and vague opponents
Eternal thoughts evanescent
Meaningless yet effervescent

A pilgrim drawn through mortal loam
Down I raked and breached alone
In cold black nothing my eyes revealed
Figures stayed in ice wrought fields

Naked sulking in cold black mud
The veins of god poured forth its blood
Among the streams in revelation
I observed a truth of profanation

The frozen forms in dark embrace
of love of sin of vile grace
Mothers, fathers, sons, and daughters
Perverse and pious among the waters

As I myself began to linger
Another lost forgotten figure
Bells rang thunderous angelic
Tones from long lost holy relic
Out beyond eternal picture
A timeless and unholy figure
Veiled in unknown epithet
Around us drew its pirouette

At end of feckless journey’s arc
Eternal in a forest dark
